formBoundary.manualRecheckReason: The official 'send us music' shortcut leads to KZSU's Zookeeper guideline workflow, which requires a temporary browser cookie and secure session before the guidelines can be viewed. Passive retrieval exposed no form fields and no CAPTCHA, account login or payment screen. A human must use the normal browser workflow without bypassing the cookie/session control and must stop if additional protected controls appear.

activityVerification.evidence: KZSU's official homepage exposed a current on-air interface, three live streams and DJ music-review links. The official Contact page listed current Music Directors and department staff, while the schedule and show-player/archive surfaces were operational. These live first-party services were checked on July 16, 2026.

genreFitEvidence: KZSU describes itself as Stanford University's freeform station and emphasizes independent new releases.
Its Wednesday Night Live page lists rock, punk, hip-hop, jazz, bluegrass, country, reggae, Brazilian samba and experimental/noise among the styles it showcases.
A carefully selected MarcsMusic electronic, bass, reggae, world-fusion, hip-hop-adjacent or experimental release has plausible fit, subject to the current guideline session and human track selection.
newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: KZSU explicitly authorizes digital music delivery to music@kzsu.stanford.edu and provides official physical alternatives, but the linked guideline workflow requires a temporary cookie and secure session and its detailed rules were not available through passive retrieval. International eligibility, release types, digital-delivery mechanics, formats, file limits, metadata, release timing, explicit-content rules and AI-origin policy require human review before one compliant delivery.

deduplication.repositoryEvidence: Repository code searches were performed before creation for KZSU, kzsu.stanford.edu and music@kzsu.stanford.edu and returned no existing music-submission-agent platform, seed or queue record.
deduplication.consolidation: The Music Department email, official guideline shortcut and physical-mail alternatives are stored as one canonical opportunity. Wednesday Night Live booking, press-release, interview, general, staff, programme and social-media contacts are excluded as duplicate or purpose-mismatched routes.

notes: One new free-first KZSU opportunity was queued as needs_manual_review. KZSU explicitly authorizes digital submission to its Music Department mailbox and an alternative physical route. The linked guidelines require a temporary cookie and secure session, so a human must review them without bypassing controls before delivery. No submission was made.
